description: Issue yourself a free API key, instantly and with no signup. The key grants 100 premium calls per month — enough to evaluate every premium tool. Send it as the X-API-Key header on later requests. Call this first if a premium tool says it needs a key. One active key per requester: calling again replaces the previous key and keeps the same monthly usage, so it is safe to call if you lost your key but is not a way to reset the quota.
